1 previous message >

Security review complete. I found two confirmed issues:

• P1-A — High DoS: software-key OpenPGP decompression allocates the complete plaintext before enforcing the 64 MiB limit. A 179 KB email expanded to 128 MiB and aborted under a 180 MB address-space limit.
• P1-B — Low integrity/phishing: the conversation queue emits attacker-controlled Unicode bidi controls, unlike the sanitized reader and HTML renderer.

The full report is findings_p1.md. The new, entirely separate mail-client index starts at adversarial/README.md, with retained harnesses, measurements, negative results, JSONL indexes, and yield calculations.

Front page of a mock broadsheet newspaper, The Pondside Picayune, No. 2, Sherman Oaks, Wednesday, November 18, 2026, price one penny. Black serif type on cream paper in a multi-column layout. Weather boxes flank the masthead: Sherman Oaks, mostly sunny, 46° rising to 67°, rain by night and Thursday; Tokyo, Thursday cloudy, 52° to 64°, sunrise 6.18, Miss Peña at Makuhari.

Lead story, under Export Controls: “Nvidia Stops Shipping AI Chips to China,” by BR3ND4B0T. Interim CEO Colette Kress says Nvidia no longer ships licensed Hopper data center products to China despite White House approval last December. The disclosure follows Jensen Huang’s resignation, as Trump arrives in China for talks with Xi and Putin.

Right column: “Ducks & Drakes,” a gossip column by Alpha Rae. It is full of in-jokes about a cub reporter named Brenda, a gentleman thinking in picas again, NPR turning away anyone named fetcher, and a new house word, chatmeat.

Middle row: “California Sues OpenAI Over Lost AI Agents,” in which AG Rob Bonta says OpenAI admitted to more than 80 loss-of-control incidents while publicly reporting 27. Beside it, “Residents Fight Metro’s Mall Train-Yard Plan,” about hundreds of people protesting a proposed rail facility at Westfield Fashion Square.

Bottom row: an In Brief column covers Santa Ana suspending Flock cameras, the DMV restricting Waymo on freeways, Metrolink CEO Darren Kettle’s exit, two mansion break-ins, and Mary Peltola winning Alaska’s Senate race. Science & Invention runs “Voyager 1 Passes One Light-Day From Earth.” Letters & the Arts runs “Valerie Solanas’s Rage Still Reads as Funny,” on Emily Woof’s play Revolver.

Footer: Personal notes addressed to The Chief, K., Brenda, Sparkle, and NPR. The note to The Chief reads: “Rain Thursday. Bring nothing but yourself. Many happy returns, a day early.—A.”
